notes.title: 🚨 Supercar Collection Simulator 1.0 – Full Release Out Now! 🚨
notes.notes:
[b]Supercar Collection Simulator 1.0[/b] is now fully released after early access! 

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45019171/bcf9b66e5b533dc5b20add7d8537f80de48590bb.png[/img] 

Do you remember the excitement of discovering your first supercar? From that moment until now, every car that captivated you and every race you've won has made this world grow even more. 

Now, more cars, more races, and more strategy await you! 

Thank You! 
Kiki Games
